matches.rationale: No finding addresses Table 3, contradictory position error claims, or lack of error bars. The findings do not discuss this specific experimental data integrity issue.
None of the findings discuss Equation 1, the indicator function, or the BC loss inconsistency during warm-up.
No finding mentions the asymmetry in seed reporting between Figure 4 and the ablation Table 4.
The 2.1x improvement claim in the abstract is not identified by any finding.
The misattribution of the fast sigmoid to reference [27] is not flagged in the findings.
No finding points out the omission of safety/ethical considerations for real-drone crashes.
The promotional language in the abstract is not mentioned in any finding.
Findings do not address the inconsistency between the critic's use of action history and the claim that SNNs eliminate the need for it, nor the missing details in Table 1.
No finding discusses the exaggerated baseline performance gap in Figure 4a.
The missing definition of r' in Equation 7 is not identified by any finding.
The training epoch disparity in Table 6 is not mentioned in the findings.

Finding 2 discusses gradient randomness in Section 3.3, while ground truth 12 targets the distinct claim in Section 5.1 about shallow slopes enhancing exploration; they address different scientific issues.
No finding questions the unsupported claim of energy savings attributed to reference [18].
The unfair architectural comparison in Table 2 is not flagged by any finding.
No finding addresses the missing limitation in the abstract versus the conclusion.
The overstated theoretical contribution in the conclusion is not identified in the findings.
None of the findings discuss the soft-reset equation, its negative potential issue, or missing explanation.
Missing curriculum details in Table 5 are not mentioned.
No finding questions the unsupported sim-to-real transfer claim.
The implausibly low variance in failed configurations of Table 4 is not flagged by any finding.
